subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Consecutive case runs collapse to a range test with an exclusive high bound (`cmpwi HI; bge` then `cmpwi LO; bge/b`), which is the only surviving source of bge-enter/b-skip pairs. A redundant beq before bge on one cmpwi means that value is a real case label whose arm coincides with default. Arms are emitted in source order: write `default:` first when the target places the default body first, and express a mid-case condition that lands in the next arm as `if (...) { ...; break; } /* fall through */`.
